chatbot.fallback: I can only answer the predefined questions listed above for this demonstration.
chatbot.welcome: Hello. I am the Portal Assistant. How can I help you today?
chatbot.q1: How do I register as a Startup?
chatbot.a1: To register, click the 'Sign In' or 'Register' button at the top right. You will need your company details, DPIIT recognition number, and PAN card.
chatbot.a2: Once you submit a solution to a challenge, it is first screened for eligibility, then evaluated by a technical expert committee. If shortlisted, you will be invited for a pilot.
chatbot.a3: Pilots are generally funded by the respective government department based on the financial estimate you provide during your application, subject to committee approval.
chatbot.q4: What is a DPIIT recognition number?
chatbot.a4: It is a unique number issued by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) to eligible startups in India.

data.c1_desc: Looking for a comprehensive AI solution to integrate with existing CCTV infrastructure to dynamically adjust traffic light timings across 50 major junctions in Pune.
data.c2_desc: We need a low-cost, rugged IoT solution that can capture basic vitals (BP, SpO2, Temp) offline and sync them to a central server when internet is available.
data.c3_desc: Seeking a highly scalable blockchain architecture to digitize and secure land mutations, preventing tampering and providing a public verification ledger.
data.c4_title: Predictive Crop Yield Modeling via Satellite
data.c4_desc: Develop machine learning models using ISRO satellite imagery to predict crop yields for 5 major drought-prone districts.
data.c5_desc: Create an interactive mobile application targeting 1st to 4th standard students to improve foundational Marathi literacy.

sectorsPage.pageDesc: The Government of Maharashtra has identified 9 core sectors where technological intervention is critical to scaling public service delivery. We actively seek startup partnerships in these domains.

data.s1_desc: Focuses on improving rural healthcare access, digital health records, remote monitoring, and affordable diagnostics.
data.s1_impact: Targeting a 30% reduction in rural clinical referral times.
data.s2_desc: Solutions for gamified regional language learning, digital classroom infrastructure, and teacher training platforms.
data.s2_impact: Aiming to improve foundational literacy in 50,000 ZP schools.
data.s3_desc: Traffic congestion management, EV charging infrastructure optimization, and public transport ticketing integration.
data.s3_impact: Reducing average commute times in tier-1 cities by 15%.
data.s4_desc: Precision farming, satellite-based yield prediction, soil health monitoring, and direct-to-market supply chains.
